d:
A gargantuan, skeletal dragon-like entity with a deep violet metallic exoskeleton and a massive, glowing red core in the center of the chest. The head is a towering, crown-like structure with glowing red eyes and a colossal, segmented tail that curls upward. It has three sharp claws on each hand and a massive, singular red claw-like structure extending from the back.
BODY COLOR: deep violet
